title: The Turtle That Breathes Backwards
hook: Some turtles can breathe through their rear ends.
script: Some turtles can breathe through their rear ends. Cold ponds can freeze over, trapping a turtle under the ice for months. With no air to reach, it pulls oxygen straight out of the water. So how does water get into its body? Through an opening called the cloaca, lined with tiny blood vessels. Its body slows almost to a stop, so it needs very little oxygen to get through the winter. What happens when the ice finally melts? It surfaces in spring, and the whole winter passed without a single breath.
